method: Same dataset; closed-window conditions first, then open conditions; one sample each in a warm editor process.
Each changed set uses StartAssetEditing, SetLabels for each object, then StopAssetEditing with mandatory cleanup; no await within the batch.
Writes include resource/progress observer overhead. StopAssetEditing is timed separately and includes the import pipeline, not just the package callback.
After actual imports, explicitly replay the production callback with duplicate paths, then observe reconciliation until settled plus a 150 ms confirmation delay.
Counts include natural notifications and replay; editor-update callbacks are not rendered frames and include empty updates. No package-absent control.
checks: Missing selected-script recovery, cached rename, label include/exclude, Undo/Redo and move passed.
Routine operations and all bursts preserve row/search generation; zero refresh object load calls during bursts.
Unavailable deletion clears canonical/saved order and selection during an intentional search rebuild.
Closed-window rename/reopen and simulated Play notifications preserve custom order and selection; stale owner rejects work.
limitations: Single observations do not establish distributions, a controlled speedup, or worst-case guarantees.
Import flush and explicit callback replay are synchronous and cannot be preempted by a cooperative timer.
Reconciliation spans editor updates but the 4 ms service budget does not bound complete callback/UI slice work.
Memory counters overlap and are not RSS. No actual Play entry, fresh process, Unity 2021.3 or other platform execution.
100k assets, type-catalog cases and the complete issue acceptance matrix remain open.
